submission.justification: Absorber-F1 at 4 mm gave the best simulated resolution at 100 GeV, 3.211%. The scan covered 2, 3, 4, 4.5, 5, 6 and 10 mm. F1 beat F2 (best 3.88% at 6 mm) and F3 (best 5.035% at 6 mm) at every thickness tested. WARNING: the residual dose rate at 1 m after one week (limit 20 uSv/h, hard requirement) could not be verified, because no dose data was found in the documents or simulation. F1 might violate this limit, so the recommendation is provisional. Confirm the activation and dose for F1 before adopting it. If F1 fails, fall back to F2, which has the next-best resolution.
